book.name: Nambas
book.title: Nambas Wen Detlot Isreil Pipul Bin Jidan Langa Deset Kantri

content: Det king blanga Moweb bin wandim Beilam det klebabalamen
Brom deya detlot Isreil pipul bin kipgon, en olabat bin kemp langa det plein kantri blanga Moweb, sanraiswei langa det Jodan Riba, najasaid langa Jeriko.
Wal wen det king blanga Moweb gulum Beilak, det san blanga Sipowa, bin irrim wanim detlot Isreil pipul bin dum langa detlot Emarait pipul en haumeni Isreil pipul bin deya,
det king en ola pipul blanga im bin brabli nogudbinji en bradin nomo lilbit.

Detlot Moweb pipul bin dalim detlot lida blanga detlot Midiyan pipul, “Detlot Isreil pipul tumatj. Olabat garra binijimap ola ebrijing weya jidan raidaran langa wi, jis laik det buligi weya oldei dagadagat det gras.” Wal det King Beilak

bin jandim sambala mesinja blanga tok langa Beilam det san blanga Biyowa, hubin jidan langa Pethora gulijap langa Yufreitis Riba langa det kantri gulum Amau. Olabat bin bringimap dijan wed brom Beilak, “Ai wandim yu garra sabi loda pipul bin kaman brom Ijip, en deibin spredatbat ebriweya na, en maitbi dei garra trai blanga deigimoba wi kantri na.

Olabat tumeni en melabat oni lilbit pipul. Wal ai wandim yu garra kaman en singim olabat blanga mi, en maitbi wi gin bidim olabat en andimwei olabat brom wi kantri. Ai sabi yu brabli klebabala en yu oldei album pipul, en wen yu tok gudwei dei jidan gudbinji, en wen yu singim olabat dei jidan brabli nogudbala.” Lagijat na deibin gibit det mesij brom King Beilak.

Wal ola Moweb lida, en ola Midiyan lida bin deigim mani blanga Beilam wulijim im gin singim olabat, en deibin gibit Beilam det wed brom Beilak hau im wandim brabli nogudbala ting blanga hepin langa detlot Isreil pipul.
Wal Beilam bin tok langa olabat, “Yumob silip iya wan nait, en tumorro ai garra dalim yumob wanim YAWEI garra dalim mi.” Wal detlot boswan lida bin stap deya garram Beilam.
Wal naitaim na God bin kaman langa Beilam en imbin askim im, “Hu detlot men jidanbat garram yu?”
Wal Beilam bin ensim im, “King Beilak brom Moweb bin jandim olabat blanga dalim mi
detlot pipul hubin kaman brom Ijip bin spredat oloba langa dijan kantri, en im wandim mi blanga singim olabat wulijim im gin fait langa olabat en andimwei olabat.” Lagijat na Beilam bin tok.
Wal God bin dalim Beilam, “Yu nomo go garram dislot men, en yu nomo singim detlot Isreil pipul, dumaji aibin gibit olabat main pawa blanga dum enijing dei wandim dum.” Lagijat na God bin tok.
Wal ailibala neksdei, Beilam bin go langa Beilak wekinmen olabat en imbin tok, “Yumob gobek langa yumob ronwan kantri. YAWEI nomo larram mi blanga go garram yumob.”
Olabat bin gobek langa Beilak en deibin dalim im Beilam nomo bin wandim kaman garram melabat.
Afta na, Beilak bin jandim bigismob lida, hubin mowa haibala langa detlot feswan.
Olabat bin go langa Beilam en gibit im dijan nyus brom Beilak. Deibin tok, “Ai askim yu, nomo larram enijing stapam yu blanga kaman langa mi.
Ai garra meigim yu brabli ritjwan en dum enijing yu askim mi. Yu garra kaman en singim dislot pipul.”

Bat Beilam bin ensim langa olabat, “Nomeda if Beilak gibit mi ol detlot silba en gol weya jidan langa im bigwan haus, bat ai stil garra dum wanim YAWEI main God wandim mi blanga dum, nomeda wanim lilwan ting im dalim mi blanga dum.
Bat yumob jidan iya wan nait laik detlot najalot bin dum wulijim ai garra sabi wanim YAWEI garra dalim mi.” Lagijat na Beilam bin tok.
Naitaim na God bin kaman langa Beilam en tok, “If dislot men bin kaman en askim yu blanga go garram olabat, yu gitredi en go, bat yu gin oni dum wanim ai dalim yu.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
Wal ailibala neksdei Beilam bin meigim redi im dongki en imbin go garram detlot Moweb lidamob.
Beilam en im dongki
Wal God bin brabli wail, dumaji Beilam bin kipgon, en wen Beilam bin raidim im dongki, en im dubala wekinmen bin go garram im, det einjul blanga YAWEI bin jandap lida langa det roud blanga stapam im.

Wen det dongki bin luk det einjul jandap lida en imbin holdimbat bigwan naif, det dongki bin libum det roud en bin go langa det fam kantri. Beilam bin beldim det dongki en bringimbek im langa det roudwei igin.
Afta na det einjul bin jandap lida langa det roud weya dubala stonwan wol blanga dubala greip fam bin gulijap langa det roud.
Wen det dongki bin luk det einjul, imbin mub wansaid langa det wol en bin ardimbat Beilam leig nomo lilbit deya langa det wol. Beilam bin beldim det dongki igin.
Wanmotaim det einjul bin mub lida en jandap langa det pleis weya dubala said bin gulijap langa det roud, en nomo eni rum bin deya langa det dubala said.
Distaim wen det dongki bin luk det einjul, det dongki bin leidan en Beilam bin git brabli wail, en imbin stat beldimbat det dongki garram im stik.
Afta na YAWEI bin gibit det dongki det pawa blanga tok. En det dongki bin tok langa Beilam, “Wanim aibin dum langa yu? Wotfo yubin beldimbat mi thritaim?”
Wal Beilam bin ensim det dongki, “Dumaji yubin mokimbat mi. If ai bina abum naif, ai bina kilim yu ded.”
Det dongki bin ensim im, “Mi na det seimwan dongki weya yubin raidimbat olataim, indit? Wal aibin tridim yu lagijat bifo?” En Beilam bin ensim im, “Nomo.”
Afta na YAWEI bin larram Beilam luk det einjul bin jandap deya garram im naif, en Beilam bin tjakam miselp feisdan langa graun.
Det einjul bin askim im, “Wotfo yubin beldimbat yu dongki lagijat thritaim? Aibin kaman blanga stapam yu, wulijim yu kaan go langa det taun.
Bat det dongki blanga yu bin luk langa mi en imbin tenim miselp wansaid thritaim. If im nomo bin dum tharran, ai bina kilim yu en libum det dongki laibala.” Lagijat na det einjul bin tok.

Wal Beilam bin ensim im, “Aibin dum nogudbala ting. Ai nomo bin sabi yubin jandap deya langa det roud blanga stapam mi. Bat if yu reken im rong blanga mi blanga kipgon, wal ai garra gobek langa main kemp na.” Lagijat na Beilam bin tok.
Bat det einjul bin tok, “Yu gin kipgon garram dislot men, bat yu garra tok oni wanim ai dalim yu blanga tok.” Wal Beilam bin kipgon garram olabat na.
Beilak bin welkam Beilam
Wal wen Beilak bin irrim det Beilam bin kaminap, imbin go blanga midim im langa Eiya det taun langa det Anan Riba langa det boda blanga Moweb.
Beilak bin tok langa im, “Wotfo yu nomo bin kaman wen aibin jandim nyus basdam? Maitbi yubin jinggabat ai kaan peiyim yu detmatj?” Lagijat na Beilak bin tok.
Beilam bin ensim im, “Aibin kaman na, bat wotkain pawa ai garram? Ai gin oni tok wanim God wandim mi blanga tok.” Lagijat na Beilam bin tok.
Wal Beilam bin go garram Beilak langa det taun gulum Husath.
Beilak bin kilim sambala buligi en ship, en imbin gibit sambala langa Beilam en langa detlot lida hubin go garram im.
Beilam bin tok det feswan wed brom YAWEI
Wal ailibala neksdei Beilak bin deigim Beilam ontop langa Beimobeil. Brom deya na Beilam bin luk sambala Isreil pipul.
